process.title: 实现 code39.py Code 39 校验字符（mod 43）及其测试
process.scope: Owns only code39.py and tests/test_code39.py. Does not own numwords.py, solids.py, any existing repository file, or any team/ file.
process.task:
Create two NEW files only: code39.py and tests/test_code39.py. Do not modify any existing file. Use only the Python standard library. Do not import numwords or solids or any non-stdlib module.

Character set and values pinned (43 characters, value = index): `0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ-. $/+%` — digits 0-9 have values 0-9, uppercase letters A-Z have values 10-35, and `-`, `.`, space, `$`, `/`, `+`, `%` have values 36-42 in that order.

Implement three functions in code39.py:
1. code39_checksum(text: str) -> str: sum the character values, take mod 43, return the character at that value. Non-str raises TypeError; empty string raises ValueError; characters outside the set (lowercase letters, `!`, etc.) raise ValueError.
2. code39_encode(text: str) -> str: returns `"*" + text + checksum + "*"`; checksum and exceptions identical to code39_checksum.
3. code39_verify(symbol: str) -> bool: non-str raises TypeError; returns True if and only if symbol starts with `*`, ends with `*`, total length >= 4, all inner characters are in the set, and the last inner character equals the checksum of the remaining inner part; returns False in all other cases (never raises otherwise).

Acceptance examples (each must have a corresponding test case in tests/test_code39.py):
- code39_checksum("A") == "A"
- code39_checksum("CODE39") == "W"
- code39_checksum("HELLO") == "B"
- code39_checksum("123") == "6"
- code39_checksum("Z") == "Z"
- code39_checksum("%") == "%"
- code39_checksum(" ") == " "
- code39_encode("CODE39") == "*CODE39W*"
- code39_encode("A") == "*AA*"
- code39_encode("123") == "*1236*"
- code39_verify("*CODE39W*") is True
- code39_verify("*CODE39X*") is False
- code39_verify("CODE39W") is False
- code39_verify("*AA*") is True
- code39_verify("*A*") is False
- code39_verify("*1236*") is True
- code39_verify("") is False
- code39_verify("**") is False
- code39_verify("*code39W*") is False
- Round-trip: code39_verify(code39_encode(t)) is True for t in "CODE39", "HELLO", "A", "123", "TEST-1"
- code39_checksum("") raises ValueError
- code39_checksum("abc") raises ValueError
- code39_checksum("HELLO!") raises ValueError
- code39_encode("") raises ValueError
- code39_checksum(123) raises TypeError
- code39_verify(123) raises TypeError

Every acceptance item above must be covered by a test case. No conflicts between body and acceptance were found for this module.
